# Quantum/quantum-inspired approach to volatility-surface forecasting

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #3,698. ## Description

Proposed quantum/quantum-inspired approach to volatility-surface forecasting: Forecast the implied-volatility surface across option strikes and expirations, then use those forecasts to inform option valuation, risk limits, or hedging. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
